# Lobsters

A developer community or index: devs reward technical detail and penalise marketing tone.

Notes from the directory list: Invite-only; 'show' tag for your own work.

## Steps
1. Open https://lobste.rs/ and read the rules (sidebar, wiki, FAQ or guidelines).
2. Write a post for this specific audience from `copy.reddit_post` / `copy.launch_post_story`, following skill/human-writing.
3. `launchkit draft lobsters -` with title, body, flair and best posting time, then `launchkit mark lobsters drafted`.
4. Only if `launch_settings.allow_social_posting` is true and the user approved this draft: post it, then mark `submitted --listing-url <post url>`.
